steps.instruction: Heat 2 tablespoons of avocado oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add 2 medium chopped onions.
steps.spoken: Add the onions and cook until tender, about 2 minutes.

steps.instruction: Stir in 4 medium cloves of minced garlic and 3 minced celery stalks.
steps.spoken: Stir in 4 medium cloves of minced garlic and 3 minced celery stalks. Stir in the garlic and celery and cook until fragrant.

steps.instruction: Add 1 medium cabbage, cut up.
Add 2 medium potatoes and 3 medium carrots, cut up.
Add 2 teaspoons each of Italian seasoning, onion powder and garlic powder.
Add 3 tablespoons of chicken bouillon and 1 teaspoon of smoked paprika.
Add 1 to 2 cups of water.
Cover the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
steps.spoken: Reduce the heat and let it simmer for about 20 minutes.

steps.instruction: Check the seasonings and adjust where necessary.
Serve warm.
Chop 1 onion.
Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a pot.
Sauté the onion in the pot until golden.
Chop 2 apples, 1 carrot and 1 parsnip.
Put the chopped apples, carrot and parsnip into the pot.
Add 4 cups of water and 1 teaspoon of nutmeg.
Add the soup mix, if using, and the juice of 1 lemon.
Cook for 1 hour, until the carrots are soft.
Blend the soup in a blender until smooth, with no lumps.
Serve the soup cold or hot.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: More Matters Recipes, US Department of Health and Human Services, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

ingredients.name: olive oil, or cooking oil of choice
dried sage, or 2 tablespoons fresh, coarsely chopped

steps.instruction: Heat 1/4 cup of olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 cup of diced onion.
steps.spoken: Add 1 cup of diced onion. Cook for 2 minutes, until the onion is soft and clear.

steps.instruction: Add 2 chopped garlic cloves and 2 cups of diced red bell pepper.
Add 2 cups of diced zucchini and 2 cups of diced yellow squash.
Add 3 cups of frozen lima beans and 3 cups of frozen corn kernels.
Season the vegetables as you like.
Cook, stirring, for 10 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
steps.spoken: Cook, stirring, for 10 minutes or longer, until the vegetables are tender.

steps.instruction: Stir in 2 teaspoons of dried sage.
steps.spoken: Stir in 2 teaspoons of dried sage, or 2 tablespoons of coarsely chopped fresh sage.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Food Hero, Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service

ingredients.name: raisins, or other dried chopped fruit

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Lightly grease a 9x13 inch pan.
Arrange the 6 split bananas in the pan.
Top the bananas evenly with 6 tablespoons of brown sugar.
Dot 4 tablespoons of margarine or butter in small pieces over the bananas.
Scatter 1/2 cup of raisins over the bananas.
steps.spoken: Scatter 1/2 cup of raisins, or other dried chopped fruit, over the bananas.

steps.instruction: Scatter 1/3 cup of chopped pecans over the top.
Bake for 30 minutes.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Eating Smart, Being Active, Colorado State University and University of California at Davis

ingredients.name: fish fillets, fresh or frozen, unbreaded

steps.instruction: If the fish is frozen, thaw it in the refrigerator overnight.
Preheat the oven to 375 °F.
Arrange 1 pound of fish fillets in a single layer in a baking dish.
Top the fish with 1/2 medium sliced onion and 1/2 medium sliced green pepper.
Mix 1 can of tomato sauce and 1 teaspoon of chili powder in a separate bowl.
Mix in 1/4 teaspoon of salt and 1/8 teaspoon of black pepper.
Pour the tomato sauce mixture over the fish and vegetables.
Cover the dish.
Bake for 20 minutes, until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
steps.spoken: Bake for 20 to thirty minutes, until the fish flakes easily with a fork.

steps.instruction: Refrigerate any leftovers.

baked-squash-with-apples-and-spices.title: Baked Squash with Apples and Spices

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Adapted from Baked Squash with Apples and Spices, Pumpkin Post and Banana Beat Newsletters, University of Massachusetts Extension, Nutrition Education Program

ingredients.name: winter squash, acorn, butternut or Hubbard
apples, Macintosh, Granny Smith or Rome

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Wash the squash and apples.
steps.spoken: Wash the squash and apples. For extra fiber, keep the peel on the apples.

steps.instruction: Cut 2 1/2 cups of squash and 1 1/2 cups of apples into slices.
Layer the squash and apples in an 8 by 8 inch pan, ending with apples.
Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of nutmeg and 1 teaspoon of cinnamon over the top layer.
Cover the pan with foil.
Bake for 45 minutes, until the squash is tender.
steps.spoken: Bake in the preheated oven for 45 to sixty minutes, until the squash is tender.

steps.instruction: Mix 1/2 cup of cornstarch with a little of the milk to make a smooth paste.
Put the rest of the 1 quart of milk and 1/4 cup of caster sugar in a pan.
Bring the milk and sugar to a boil.
Add the cornstarch paste.
steps.spoken: Add the cornstarch paste and boil for about 10 minutes.

steps.instruction: Let the mixture cool a little.
Stir in 2 beaten egg yolks until the mixture thickens.
Stir in 1/2 teaspoon of vanilla extract and 2 thinly sliced bananas.
When cool, pour the mixture into the prepared mould.
Chill for a few hours to set.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Simple Healthy Recipes, Oklahoma Nutrition Information and Education, ONIE Project

ingredients.name: green salsa, or 16 ounce jar of enchilada sauce
pinto or kidney beans, low-sodium, rinsed and drained, 15 ounces

steps.instruction: Place 2/3 pound of ground beef and 1 chopped bell pepper in a large saucepan.
Add 1 can of diced tomatoes and 1 chopped onion.
Cook over medium heat for 8 minutes, stirring often, until the beef is browned.
steps.spoken: Cook over medium heat for 8 to ten minutes, stirring often, until the beef is browned.

steps.instruction: Drain the fat from the pan.
Stir in 6 garlic cloves, 1 tablespoon chili powder and 2 teaspoons cumin for 15 seconds.
steps.spoken: Add 6 chopped garlic cloves, 1 tablespoon of chili powder and 2 teaspoons of cumin. Cook for 15 seconds, until fragrant.

steps.instruction: Stir in 1 3/4 cups of green salsa.
Bring the pan to a boil.
Reduce the heat and cover the pan.
Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring now and then.
steps.spoken: Simmer for 10 to fifteen minutes, stirring now and then.

steps.instruction: Add 1 can of beans and cook until heated.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Adapted from Sensational Six-Layer Dinner, One Dish Meals, University of Wisconsin Cooperative Extension Service, A Family Living Program

ingredients.name: ground beef, 90% lean, browned and drained

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Lightly spray a baking dish with cooking spray.
Layer 2 medium sliced potatoes in the dish.
Add a layer of 2 cups of sliced carrots.
Sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper on top.
Add a layer of 1/2 cup of sliced onion.
Add a layer of 1 pound of ground beef, browned and drained.
Add a layer of 1 1/2 cups of green beans.
Spread 1 can of low-sodium tomato soup on top.
Cover the dish.
Bake for 45 minutes, until tender and heated through.
Uncover the dish and bake 15 more minutes.
Whisk 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil and 1/4 cup of apple juice in a small bowl.
Whisk in 2 tablespoons of cider vinegar and 2 teaspoons of Dijon mustard.
Whisk in 1/4 teaspoon of salt and 1 dash of black pepper.
Shred or thinly slice 1 small head of cabbage.
Cut 1 apple and 1 bell pepper into small chunks.
Place the cabbage, apple, pepper and 1/4 cup of sliced almonds in a large bowl.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Kentucky Families on the Move, University of Kentucky Cooperative Extension Service

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Grease a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish.
Put 1 can of cream-style corn and 3 3/4 cups of cooked broccoli in the dish.
Mix in 1 beaten egg, 1/2 cup of cracker crumbs and 1/4 cup of oil.
Mix 6 crushed saltine crackers and 1 tablespoon of melted margarine in a small bowl.
Sprinkle the cracker topping over the corn mixture.
Bake for 40 minutes.

ingredients.name: boneless chicken or turkey, cooked and diced
lima beans, cooked or canned low-sodium
whole kernel corn, canned low-sodium or cooked

steps.instruction: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large pan.
Add 1 chopped medium onion and cook until tender.
Add 2 cups of chicken broth.
Add 2 cups of diced, cooked boneless chicken or turkey.
Add 2 cups of tomatoes.
Add 2 cups of lima beans.
Add 2 cups of whole kernel corn.
Simmer over medium-low heat for 30 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bring the pot to a simmer, then keep it at medium-low heat for 30 minutes.

steps.instruction: Makes 8 servings of about 1 cup each.

ingredients.name: white button mushrooms, rinsed and quartered
leeks, split into quarters, then sliced into small squares and rinsed well
skinless chicken legs or thighs (4 whole legs, split, or 8 thighs)
fresh herbs, such as parsley and chives (2 tablespoons of each), rinsed, dried and minced (or 2 teaspoons dried)

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a heavy roasting or braising pan.
steps.spoken: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a heavy roasting or braising pan. Heat the olive oil in a medium heavy-bottom roasting or braising pan. A large sauté pan with a metal handle will work as well.

steps.instruction: Add 10 ounces of quartered mushrooms to the pan.
steps.spoken: Add 10 ounces of quartered mushrooms to the pan. Add the mushrooms and cook for 3 to five minutes, until golden brown.

steps.instruction: Add 1 cup each of leeks, potatoes, celery and pearl onions.
steps.spoken: Add the leeks, potatoes, celery and pearl onions, 1 cup of each. Keep cooking for 3 to five more minutes, until the vegetables become soft.

steps.instruction: Add 3 cups of low-sodium chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add 1 pound of skinless chicken legs or thighs to the pan.
Cover the pan and place it in the oven for 20 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover the pan and place it in the oven for about 20 minutes, until the chicken is tender when pierced with a fork and a thermometer reads 165 °F.

steps.instruction: Remove the chicken from the pan and return the pan to the stovetop.
Bring the liquid to a boil, then add the herbs and 1 tablespoon of lemon juice.
Mix 1 tablespoon of cornstarch with 2 tablespoons of sour cream and add it to the pan.
Bring the pan back to a boil, then remove it from the heat.
Season with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper, then pour sauce over the chicken.
steps.spoken: Season with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper, then pour sauce over the chicken. Pour 1 cup of the vegetables and sauce over the chicken.

steps.instruction: Mix 1 2/3 cups of cream, 5 fluid ounces of milk and 5 egg yolks in a bowl.
Add 7 tablespoons of sugar, the vanilla bean and the rubbed lemon peel.
Let the mix rest for 30 minutes.
steps.spoken: Let the mix rest for at least 30 minutes. You can also let it rest overnight.

steps.instruction: Pour the mix into 4 to six ovenproof ramekins.
Preheat the oven to 300 °F with a roasting pan on the middle rack.
Set the ramekins in the pan and fill the pan with boiling water.
Let the custard cook for 55 minutes.
Cool the ramekins to room temperature.
Chill the ramekins in the fridge for at least 2 hours.
Spread 1 teaspoon of sugar over the top of each ramekin.
Melt the sugar on top with a kitchen torch.
steps.spoken: Melt the sugar on top with a kitchen torch. The grill of your oven may work too.

steps.instruction: Season 2 chicken breasts with 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon pepper.
steps.spoken: Season 2 boneless chicken breasts with 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper.

steps.instruction: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Lay the chicken in the hot pan.
Flip and cook 6 more minutes, until a thermometer reads 165 °F.
steps.spoken: Flip the chicken and cook about 6 more minutes, until a thermometer reads 165 °F in the thickest part.

steps.instruction: Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Heat 3 tablespoons of butter in a large pan.
Add 1 cup of onion, 2 cloves of minced garlic and 1/2 teaspoon of salt.
steps.spoken: Add 1 cup of onion, 2 cloves of minced garlic and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Add the chopped onion, the minced garlic and the salt. Cook until the onions are soft.

steps.instruction: Add 2 pounds of chopped raw spinach and cook for 2 minutes.
Mix in 4 cups of cooked brown rice, 4 beaten eggs and 1 cup of milk.
Mix in 1 1/2 cups of grated cheddar and 1/4 cup of chopped parsley.
Mix in 2 tablespoons of tamari and 3 dashes each of nutmeg and cayenne.
steps.spoken: Mix in 2 tablespoons of tamari and 3 dashes each of nutmeg and cayenne. Mix in 2 tablespoons of tamari and a few dashes each of nutmeg and cayenne.

steps.instruction: Spread it in a buttered casserole dish.
Sprinkle 1/4 cup of sunflower seeds and 3 dashes of paprika on top.
steps.spoken: Sprinkle 1/4 cup of sunflower seeds and 3 dashes of paprika on top. Sprinkle 1/4 cup of sunflower seeds and a few dashes of paprika on top.

steps.instruction: Cover the dish and bake for 35 minutes.
